Body.Content:
The new pricing calculation API allows external systems to programmatically retrieve active prices or price quotes directly from Supply Chain Management. Based on key input data provided by the external system—such as product and customer details—Supply Chain Management provides real-time pricing and discount calculation results.

The API returns a product’s calculated price, including simple discounts. It doesn't calculate multiline discounts and assumes that each product in a request has a quantity of one.

Business Value:

Empower external applications to retrieve accurate, real-time pricing and discount calculation results directly from Supply Chain Management. Seamlessly integrate pricing logic into your sales channels to enhance quoting and pricing consistency.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/supply-chain/unified-pricing-management/upm-pricing-calculation-api

GA date: June CY2026

Preview date: April CY2026
